items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 180:1
items.html: The screen of ZA locks Beriah, for it is a screen of phase one, and what passes through it is the aspect of VAK without a head. And it is found to lock the light of Beriah, which is the aspect of GAR, so that nothing passes from it and downward. And likewise it guards it from the externals. Therefore it is called by the name a shoe. (Item 39).
